grouped_png_assets._section: PNG decorative border art — grouped across all editions
grouped_png_assets.justification_for_grouping: 5290 PNG files totalling ~104MB. All are decorative border art images (apples, bats, birds, etc.) referenced by ST_Border enum values in wml.xsd. They are: (1) binary image files with no schema content, (2) not embedded in generated DOCX output, (3) referenced only by name in the ST_Border enum which is already extracted, (4) identical across editions (same files duplicated), (5) have zero impact on packaging, XML structure, serialization, or TypeScript modeling. The ST_Border enum values are already captured in spec-extraction.json. The PNG files themselves are not needed.
